# Survey grid cases: the inputs to Mission Planner's Grid.CreateGrid for the golden outputs in
# golden/, and to crates/mp-mission/tests/grid_vectors.rs. Regenerate the goldens with
# tools/csharp-reference/regen-grid.sh after any change here; see README.md.
#
#   polygon <name> <lat>,<lng> ...          vertices in drawing order, degrees
#   case <name> <polygon> [<param>=<value> ...]
#
# Parameters are CreateGrid's own names (ExtLibs/Utilities/Grid.cs:354). One that is left out takes
# the value GridUI gives it on a fresh install - the list is in tools/csharp-reference/MpGrid.cs -
# including the angle, which GridUI sets to the bearing of the polygon's longest side.
